Ever since I started working on robot foundation models a handful of years ago, the broad ability to one-shot in-context learn has been the single most vivid goal in my mind along the long road ahead. It’s something @andyzengineer  and I have especially been thinking together on

We've improved how GEN-1 learns to adapt to new actuators and new robots at the lowest level, with up to 10-20x gains on internal benchmarks. This significantly boosts performance on high-precision tasks like disassembling parts from a NIST board.\
